# Function overrideFeatureEnabled

  * overrideFeatureEnabled(  
featureName: [PROGRESSIVE_SSE_STREAMING](../enums/FeatureName.html#progressive_sse_streaming),  
enabled: boolean | undefined,  
): void

Programmatically override a feature's enabled state.

This override takes highest priority, superseding environment variables and registry defaults.

#### Parameters

    * featureName: [PROGRESSIVE_SSE_STREAMING](../enums/FeatureName.html#progressive_sse_streaming)

The feature name to override.

    * enabled: boolean | undefined

Whether the feature should be enabled.

#### Returns void
